Section 12.2 Termination for Cause / Material Breach: Either Party may terminate this Agreement or any specific SOW immediately upon written notice if the other Party commits a material breach of any provision hereof and fails to cure such material breach within thirty (30) calendar days after receipt of written notice specifying the breach with reasonable detail.

Section 12.3 Termination for Convenience: Customer may terminate this Agreement or any active Service Order for convenience without cause at any time upon providing at least sixty (60) days prior written notice to Provider. In the event Customer exercises termination for convenience, Customer shall pay all earned fees for Services performed through the effective termination date.

Section 14.1 Assignment and Sublicensing: Neither Party may assign or transfer this Agreement, whether by merger, reorganization, or operation of law, without prior written consent.
